an4.36:3.3: ‘Might you be a centaur?’ being asked,
an4.36:3.4: you answer that you will not be a centaur.
an4.36:3.5: ‘Might you be a spirit?’ being asked,
an4.36:3.6: you answer that you will not be a spirit.
an4.36:3.7: ‘Might you be a human?’ being asked,
an4.36:3.8: you answer that you will not be a human.
an4.36:4.2: …if I had not given up defilements I might have become a centaur … a spirit … or a human. But I have given up those defilements, cut them off at the root, made them like a palm stump, obliterated them so they are unable to arise in the future.
